findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Rate is the larger source of error (50.37 yds from volume vs 53.03 from rate). Fix the rate model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.54 per player (projected 29.57, actual 30.11).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is under-projected by 0.12 (projected 7.16, actual 7.27).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 66.61, without it 65.03. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 8/28 (28.57%). Our MAE 66.61 vs the line's 56.75. The book is the better projection.
